title: ITR-3 Schedule CG (Capital Gains) - data
description: A ledger of disposals, not a set of totals. Schedule CG's own boxes are derived from these rows by engine/, because the rate that applies to a row depends on its asset class, its holding period and its transfer date - and the 23-Jul-2024 changeover means two disposals of the same scrip in one year can attract different rates.

asset_class.description: Decides the section and the rate. 'equity_stt' is listed equity or equity-oriented mutual funds where STT was paid (111A / 112A); 'debt_mf_specified' is a specified mutual fund under 50AA, always short-term whatever the holding period.

full_value.description: Sale consideration as the document states it. Say in basis whether the figure is before charges or already net of them: charges already taken off here must not be reported again in transfer_expenses.

cost_of_acquisition.description: Purchase value as the document states it. Where the document states the charges paid on purchase separately, leave them out of this figure and report them in purchase_expenses; engine/ adds the two.

purchase_expenses.description: Charges paid to acquire the asset that the document states separately from the purchase value: brokerage, stamp duty, exchange and SEBI charges, GST. They are part of the cost of acquisition and engine/ adds them to it. Never securities transaction tax.

transfer_expenses.description: Expenditure wholly and exclusively in connection with the transfer, as the document states it for this sale: brokerage, exchange and SEBI charges, GST, stamp duty. Never securities transaction tax, for which section 48 allows no deduction.

stt.description: Securities transaction tax the document states for this trade. Recorded so that it can be seen to have been left out: it is deducted nowhere in computing a capital gain.

fmv_31jan2018.description: Grandfathering under 112A. Required for equity acquired before 01-02-2018; leave out otherwise.

stated_gain.description: The gain the document itself states, if it states one. Reported for cross-checking; engine/ computes its own.

stated_term.description: How the document classified it, if it did. engine/ derives the term from the dates and flags any disagreement.

totals.description: Only what the documents themselves state, for reconciliation against the ledger. Never your own arithmetic.
